warnings: Axes: x = grids 1-7 at 4.50 (27.00) left to right; y = rows A, B, C printed top-to-bottom on every structural plan (A-B 6.50, B-C 2.00, A-C 8.50). Origin A1 (top-left). Same 7 x 3 grid on S-01, S-02, S-03 and S-04 — no conflict between sheets.

Dummies: x 1' (-1.00) / 7' (28.00) = roof edge on S-03/S-04. y A' (-1.60) / C'' (10.10) = roof eave edge on S-03, S-04, both truss T1 elevations (S-07) and the top chain of section A-A; A'' (-1.00) / C' (9.50) = the 1.00 offsets on the bottom chain of section A-A (architectural sheet หน้า09).
The roof ridge line (แนวสันหลังคา on S-04) is not dimensioned on any sheet — no dummy line invented for it.

Swept for ticks: all structural sheets S-01..S-10 (หน้า16-25; S-01..S-07 print dimensions) plus section A-A (หน้า09) for the levels. The other architectural sheets (floor plan, roof plan, elevations, door/window and wall details, หน้า05-08, 10-15) and the electrical plan (หน้า26) were NOT swept — op04 scope; this master is complete for the structural set only.
Scanned set (สพฐ. standard drawing) with handwritten pen marks from someone's takeoff on S-01 (circled 'C2' at row C); pen marks are not part of the drawing and are not recorded as dimensions.
